title: jq command not available in agent environment
description: Agent attempted to use jq for JSON parsing but the command was not available in the test harness environment.
symptoms: Exit code 127: /bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found
root_cause_hint: jq is not installed in the Docker container or agent execution environment.
evidence: Exit code 127: /bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found
